audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: full phases[0..4].side all read "Skill" while content win[0..4] all read "Brand". Packet also flags the chart giving Brand 5/7 against a 53.74% Azir win rate.
audit.why: Brand outranges Azir early (Sear 1050, Pillar of Flame 900 vs soldier reach) so levels 1-3 are genuinely his; Emperor's Divide at 6 answers his all-in and the win rate confirms Azir ahead from there.
audit.corrected: Brand / Brand / Brand / Skill / Azir / Azir / Azir, with both layers proposed in pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] pointed at Liandry's/Shurelya's-Sheen components, which are not Azir's build path, and spikes[1] used the fabricated ability name "Ares of Blaze".
audit.why: Azir's inflection is Nashor's Tooth into Rabadon's; Brand's R is Pyroclasm (100/90/80s), which bounces 5 times and stacks Blaze to max.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Emperor's Divide (120/105/90) vs Pyroclasm commit; 1st item = Nashor's Tooth; late = Rabadon's.

audit.whatIsWrong: No concrete cooldown sequencing anywhere; breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The decisive interaction is that Sear only stuns a target already ablaze — Blaze must be applied by W or E first. Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Conflagration 13/12/11/10/9, all far shorter than Azir's E at 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: State the ablaze prerequisite, the real Q/W/E cooldowns, and that Azir's E is the long one to budget around.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d claimed a "fifteen-second invitation" for a spent Sear.
audit.why: Sear is 8s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5.
Kit files list no spell-shield/QSS/tenacity data for either champion and missingInteractions is empty, so no hidden-mechanic claim is asserted.

edits.before: W a soldier behind the wave and farm THROUGH it — your auto range is the soldier's range. Don't poke yet; sand costs mana.
edits.after: Sear is 1050 range and Pillar of Flame 900 — both outrange your sand. Farm through the soldier, eat no free burn, poke later.

edits.before: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only when his engage is down.
edits.after: Once Blaze is on you Sear stuns, so his 8-second Q is the lane. Trade only in that gap: W-Q the drag-through, then step back.

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.
edits.after: Shifting Sands is your out, but it is 22s at rank 1 — with Pillar of Flame back every 10s he still owns the ground between you.

edits.before: Nashor's components arrive and the soldier DPS starts to sting. Drag Qs through Brand on every last-hit he takes.
edits.after: Nashor's components arrive and soldier DPS stings. Drag Q through him on his last-hits while Conflagration's 11s is spent.

edits.before: Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip. With R up you win every 2v2 your jungler joins.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide answers the all-in: the knockback ends his Pyroclasm follow-up and wins every 2v2 your jungler joins.

edits.before: Sustained poke advantage continues to snowball if you can't answer his damage
edits.after: Soldier DPS catches up here — his combo still kills, but only if Sear connects first

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shifting Sands for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sear is 8s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5, and it only stuns while Blaze is on you — so after his W or E lands, the stun line is the one dodge that matters. - Pillar of Flame 10s, Conflagration 13s: step up inside that gap. - Your E is 22s at rank 1; hold it.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Brand on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Sear is 6s at max rank and Conflagration 9s. With both spent he has no stun and no spread — walk up then and empty three soldiers into him before they return.

edits.before: Brand burns Sear (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Brand burns Sear on nothing — take the six-to-eight-second invitation.

edits.before: That’s Brand’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame is a delayed 900-range zone — standing still is what it wants.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Brand player is waiting for.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is 120s at rank 1 — spend it to stop his all-in or to insec him, never to chip a wave the soldiers already clear.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze first, landing Sear for the stun, and detonating Pillar of Flame before you can dash out.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry through siege — soldiers take plates and R denies his engage; Brand's damage is a four-second burn, yours is a whole fight.

edits.before: If Brand opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sear (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Brand opens the score his Blaze detonations clear the wave off you and the zoning costs CS. Farm at soldier range, never with minions lined up behind you on his Sear angle, and scale.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is the inflection; level 6 adds dive insurance; Rabadon's turns poke into deletion.
edits.after: Nashor's is the inflection; level 6 walls his Pyroclasm commit; Rabadon's turns soldier poke into deletion.

edits.before: Ares of Blaze gives him a delayed AoE detonation that punishes you for standing near your own soldiers when he all-ins with Sear stun.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces five times and stacks Blaze to max, so his level 6 all-in is Sear stun into a detonation you cannot walk out of.

edits.before: Once you finish Liandry's/Shurelya's-Sheen components your poke trades and wave clear finally out-scale his burst combo.
edits.after: Once Nashor's Tooth is finished your soldier autos out-trade him: he has 8s of cooldowns against your continuous soldier DPS.

edits.before: With Liandry's or Shurelya's online your wave clear and poke range eclipse his kit, and in teamfights your ultimate splits his team while soldiers zone his Pillar angles — full-build Azir simply has more range and more damage than a squishy mage with no mobility.
edits.after: With Nashor's and Rabadon's online your wave clear and soldier range eclipse his kit, and in teamfights Emperor's Divide splits his team before Pyroclasm can chain — full-build Azir has more range and more sustained damage than a mage with no mobility.

edits.before: Stack items toward Shurelya's/Liandry's to survive to 2-item spike
edits.after: Rush Nashor's Tooth, then Rabadon's — survive to the two-item spike

notes: Chart was cross-layer contradictory (full "Skill" x5 vs content "Brand" x5); resolved to Brand/Brand/Brand/Skill/Azir/Azir/Azir with paired side+win edits and matching why rewrites. spikes[1] fabricated name "Ares of Blaze" replaced with Pyroclasm. Build references to Shurelya's/Sheen removed — not an Azir path. All cooldowns quoted come from the kit file. No spell-shield/QSS/tenacity claims made: kit needsResearch is empty.
